name: Token-dependent ChordRes
tagline: Per-token Chord controls from position and velocity.
description: A separate zero-initialized linear map reads position and velocity at each Chord sublayer. Its six outputs condition the lookahead, position update and tangent velocity update.
mechanism: Position and velocity jointly predict the coefficients at each site
Zero-start projections preserve the initial static model
Triton fuses per-token controls into the saved-force Chord path
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.

nodes: Chord read, branch and tangent write
